purpose: Before selecting a support/mode hypothesis group, query the actual ancestor at the same current clock for F_b011_s030__reference to bind the current-state observable to its true same-time ancestor, and query the measured controller response for the same region to separate real dose/normalization effects from function-direction effects. These two tools are the minimum needed to distinguish 'wrong function direction' from 'insufficient real dose' before handoff; no affinity derivative or SMC is assumed.
